paper_title: First results from the Axion Dark-Matter Birefringent Cavity (ADBC) experiment
notes: First results from ADBC optical birefringent bow-tie cavity axion DM search. Paper reports 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma over three disjoint mass windows: 40.9-43.3 neV (9.88-10.45 MHz), 49.3-50.6 neV (11.92-12.22 MHz), 54.4-56.7 neV (13.12-13.69 MHz), with an AVERAGE sensitivity of 1.9e-8 GeV^-1. Actual limit curve (Fig. 3) varies roughly 1e-9 to 1e-7 across bins but no numerical table is provided; the emitted points encode the average limit as flat segments over each probed window (three pairs of endpoints). Haloscope DM search assuming rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 and standard halo model.
